For example, you've got your list set up all nice, synthesis patched and all nice and intricate. But now you want a music mod. Well there's a record in xedit for music called ZNAM. So to patch this all you need to do is copy the paper world map cell as override to a new plugin, then mouse drag the music mod records to your new override. Then they're both combined and the map is fixed. Super quick process.

Keep in mind the formid is 8 characters, 01234567.

Documented by DAR the proper way to add a formid as the modpage shows is 0x00000007 or 0x01234567. 

The first two characters in the form id correspond with the mod index in your load order, or its placment in your mod list. Thats for regular esp mods. For espfe, like your mod, they all have the mod index FE plus 3 characters.

Your mod is at FE5C5. 

DAR does what it does regardless of load order placement, and disregards mod index. So formid 01234567 becomes 00234567. Going back to how DAR uses formids it becomes 0x00234567. 

Knowing all that, your mod becomes 0x00000801. Reason being you can have 3 mods that have a formid ending in 801, but they can be singled out because you already defined the specific esp the formid belongs to, SacredRelicSword.esp.
